reading.title: A day at home with a cold
reading.text: Yesterday I did not go to school. I had a cold and a headache. My mother called the doctor. The doctor said, 'Stay in bed, drink hot tea and rest.' I did not feel well, but in the afternoon I felt a little better. My mother made soup and I ate it with bread. This morning I feel fine, so I am going to school. Tomorrow I will wear a scarf!

listening.title: Tips for a healthy life
listening.script: My name is Doctor Karimova. Here are my tips for a healthy life. First, eat fruit and vegetables every day. Second, drink a lot of water. Third, do exercise for thirty minutes, for example swimming or cycling. Fourth, go to bed early and sleep for eight hours. If you feel stressed, relax and talk to your family.

reading.title: Zafar's birthday
reading.text: Today Zafar is very happy because it is his birthday. In the morning he was a bit tired, but he got up early. His mother made his favourite breakfast. At school his friends said, 'Happy birthday!' and Zafar was surprised because they gave him a present. After school he was hungry and thirsty, so he ate cake and drank juice. In the evening his cousin could not come to the party. Zafar was a little sad, but he said, 'I hope to see you next week!'

reading.title: Sevara's Saturday
reading.text: On Saturday morning Sevara said, 'Good morning, Mum!' Her mother answered, 'Good morning! How are you?' 'Fine, thanks. And you?' 'Not too bad, thanks.' It was her brother's birthday, so everybody said, 'Happy birthday!' In the afternoon her brother had a football match. Sevara said, 'Good luck!' He won the match, and she said, 'Well done!' In the evening she said, 'Goodnight, see you tomorrow!'

reading.title: Choosing a film
reading.text: Lola and her friend Dilya want to do something on Saturday. 'Why don't we go to the cinema?' says Lola. 'Good idea,' says Dilya. 'Which film do you want to see?' 'I don't mind. It's up to you.' 'How about the new cartoon?' 'Absolutely! I love cartoons.' They decide to meet at around five o'clock. Then Dilya remembers her brother's birthday dinner. 'Oh dear! I can't come,' she says. 'What a pity!' says Lola. 'It doesn't matter. Let's go on Sunday.'

reading.title: Our picnic
reading.text: On Sunday my family went for a picnic in the park. My mother made sandwiches with bread and tomatoes. We took rice and carrots, a big bottle of mineral water and orange juice. My father brought some fruit: apples, grapes and bananas. My little sister does not like onions, so she did not eat the salad. I ate a lot of strawberries! After the picnic we were full and tired.
